turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for acting against a student, and I have its own guide in my bag. So what else do you have, Hale?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead. I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here anyway, and I'll want whatever you send them in writing. Now, who decided on the zero, and did anyone call me before it went in?
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Tomorrow is Wednesday, the eleventh. Good, I'll want the date on whatever you file. Does it say anyone spoke to Owen first, or that nobody called me before his mark was entered?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you explain who decided on it and why neither Owen nor I was contacted first, and that nothing be placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology and a trip to the principal, and she agreed to nothing, so this is not the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because you never showed anything specific, dated and checkable that she could test.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score and then threatened to make it official, and she took the score as a machine's guess and the threat as an invitation to go to the principal herself.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you said nothing about times or his process, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after she asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it was entered before you called her, then show one dated document about how Owen worked on the essay.
